criteria.detail: Partial. One real Claude Code 2.1.317 run on the Mac with the dispatch account delivered from the main node on a RAM disk for the run only: subscription login confirmed by the initialize answer before the prompt (Guard), pinned digest bound, Keychain-denying Seatbelt, environment read-back with no paid-API variable. Not yet through the signed relay; capability comparison against an accepted revision and the falsifier are not registered. Round 4: one real Claude Code dispatch went through invoke_remote, SSH, the production Mac receiver and the signed relay with the login delivered on a RAM disk; the Mac profile was a candidate without a qualification stamp, and the handshake guard and capability comparison did not run on that path. Round 6: one more real Claude Code leg through the relay with the stream kept (mac-relay-claude-leg.json).

Waiting. The only free-at-launch-allowed Codex login (codex2) was leased by another run; codex1 is at its weekly limit. The Codex frame (auth.json without the refresh credential) is unit-tested only; Codex 0.166.0 is not installed on the Mac. Round 4: Codex 0.166.0 installed on the Mac; one real dispatch ran the whole relay path with CODEX_HOME delivered on a RAM disk and no paid-API key, but the first turn failed (workspace routing discovery failed). Not qualified. Round 5: cause of the failed turn found and fixed (the run's sandbox denies the keychain service Codex takes its root certificates from; the Mac Codex run now reads the system root file through SSL_CERT_FILE). One real Codex 0.166.0 dispatch through invoke_remote and the production receiver completed its turn: exit 0, usage reported, file edited, CODEX_HOME the delivered RAM-disk profile, no paid-API variable, nothing kept. Still pending: candidate Mac profile, no capability comparison on the relay path. Round 6: one more real Codex leg through the relay with the stream kept (mac-relay-codex-leg.json).

Partial. The Mac engine stdout (63 lines) and stderr relayed over SSH matched the Mac copy line by line after exact redaction; the unit called Bash (error output seen), Read and Edit. The engine stderr was empty on the passing run, so the error-stream leg is not yet exercised; not through the production receiver; falsifier not registered. Round 5: still open; READINESS.txt (Round 5) lists what is missing, including the exit commitment, which needs files outside the footprint. Round 6: built. One ordered stream from the Mac wrapper, relayed by control_worker, kept by RemoteLaunch as the execution record; the exit commits the stream totals the Mac signed and the record is refused as unknown_outcome:record_incomplete unless the main node received exactly those. One real leg per engine passed with equal totals (mac-relay-claude-leg.json, mac-relay-codex-leg.json). Falsifiers mac147-drop-error-stream and mac147-record-comparison-skipped registered. Open: see READINESS.txt, Round 6.

Partial (login only). The account login travels in one frame on SSH stdin, lands mode 0600 on a RAM disk in a 0700 directory and is detached after the run; no value in the kept record, the Mac process command lines or environments; keychain Claude items unchanged. MCP server secrets frame and its falsifier not implemented. Round 4: the secrets frame travels after the binding on the receiver channel and is written 0600 in a 0700 directory on the run RAM disk after acceptance; falsifier mac147-value-in-packet registered. The engine does not read the file yet (fixed arguments in the Mac wrapper). Round 6 (lead decision): the secrets frame is removed; no outside-service credential is sent to a Mac run (VELDO-0254). A run selecting a credentialed MCP server is refused as unsupported_configuration:credential_in_run:<server>. The MCP part waits for VELDO-0257. mac147-value-in-packet now plants the login value.
